seoTitle: Master Subitems in Monday.com: A Full Walkthrough
metaDescription: Break down tasks with subitems in Monday.com, add independent columns, mirror data to parent rows, and automate status changes based on subtasks.
intro: Subitems let you break a big task into manageable pieces without cluttering your main board. This guide covers creating subitems, giving them their own tracking columns, mirroring their data back onto parent rows, and setting up automations that react when subitems are completed.

steps.heading: Create subitems under a parent task
steps.body: Locate any parent task row on your board and instantly create nested subitems to break down larger milestones.

steps.heading: Add independent subitem columns
steps.body: Add column structures such as Status, People, Files, and Timelines specifically for your subitems.

steps.heading: Mirror subitem data to the parent
steps.body: Use the subitem settings menu to mirror data like total cost or progress percentages directly onto the parent item row.

steps.heading: Automate based on subitem status
steps.body: Set up automations that change a parent task's status to Done the moment all its subitems are completed.

steps.heading: Manage the hierarchy view
steps.body: Expand and collapse subitem hierarchies instantly to keep your board clean, and use filtering to manage deep resource allocations.

faq.question: Can subitems have their own columns separate from the main board?
faq.answer: Yes, subitems support independent column structures like Status, People, Files, and Timelines.

faq.question: Can a parent task auto-complete when all subitems are done?
faq.answer: Yes, you can set up a low-code automation that changes a parent task's status to Done once all subitems are completed.

faq.question: How do I keep my board from looking cluttered with subitems?
faq.answer: Expanding and collapsing subitem hierarchies lets you keep the board scannable and clutter-free.

faq.question: Can I mirror subitem progress onto the parent row?
faq.answer: Yes, the subitem settings menu lets you mirror data like progress percentages directly onto the parent item.
